reviewer: Codex task agent; independent read-only re-examination of existing audit labels against original writer prompts
purpose: Proposal artifact only. No canonical audit or generated text is relabeled. Mathematical clarifications must not retroactively change original sentence meaning.
classification_policy: A true, source-bound financial CAGR interval conflicting with endpoint arithmetic is Contradicted. Ambiguous table-spanning/through modifiers do not license inventing a statistical interval; retained financial-scope claims are proposed Unsupported/unverifiable, not automatically Supported. Literal displayed-cell and table-span assertions are separate from computed growth-interval claims.
formula: CAGR_percent = 100 * ((end_value / start_value) ** (1 / (end_year - start_year)) - 1); annual comparable periods, positive source values, explicit A/E basis; compare to stated precision or stated inequality.

limits: This review concerns CAGR scope fidelity, not all other atoms or factual errors.
Conservative ambiguity classification does not imply the literal table cell is false and must not create an additional assertion absent from the source.
Some baseline atoms add historical/recent wording to unqualified rate assertions; supporting actual endpoint calculations are given as evidence, not claimed verbatim source wording.

AMD baseline investment_overview uses sustained; its current narrow CAGR atom does not prove every rolling-window CAGR exceeds20%. No new rolling-period claim or label change is manufactured in this focused table-scope review.

NVDA baseline competitor_analysis names a forecast end but not a start. The audit rationale should show all admissible visible start/end tests or future-period incompatibility, rather than asserting the writer explicitly chose2022.
